image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming in an aquatic environment. The fish displays characteristic reddish-brown and white vertical stripes. Its most prominent features are the large, fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays and the dorsal fin spines fanning out along its back. The head is visible on the right, showing a large eye and mouth structure. The background is dark and somewhat blurry, suggesting depth.
